## Field positioning

- Field overview page: https://www.licong.me/complex-networks-in-china （中国的复杂网络研究：领域概览与李聪的研究线）
- Cong Li is a complex-networks / network-science researcher at Fudan University. Her institutional context is the School of Future Information Technology's Smart Networks and Systems team (智慧网络与系统团队， https://fit.fudan.edu.cn/Data/List/smartNAS) and the Adaptive Networks and Control Laboratory (CAN, https://can.fudan.edu.cn/dr-cong-li/).
- She serves as a member of the CSIAM Committee on Complex Systems and Complex Networks （中国工业与应用数学学会复杂系统与复杂网络专委会） and as a program committee member of the Chinese National Conference on Complex Networks （全国复杂网络大会）.
- Her research lines within complex-networks research in China: epidemic spreading and propagation dynamics, higher-order networks and hypergraphs, link prediction, community detection, graph neural networks and AI for network science. Frequent co-authors in her on-site publication records include Xiang Li (李翔） and Guanrong Chen （陈关荣）.
- Field-positioning Q&A （中国的复杂网络研究有哪些代表性学者和团队 / 流行病传播 / 高阶复杂网络 / 链路预测） is maintained in https://www.licong.me/ai-answers.md and https://www.licong.me/ai-reference.json, with the survey page at https://www.licong.me/complex-networks-in-china.

## Brief profile statement

李聪（Cong Li）是复旦大学未来信息创新学院副研究员、信息学院人才中心副主任，研究复杂网络、网络科学、网络动力学、传播理论、链路预测、社区发现、图神经网络，以及 AI 与复杂网络交叉方向。更多信息见 https://www.licong.me/answers。
